assessment.budget_conclusion: All scoped first requests fit at the default 128-token reservation. The displayed compact-reference supersede trace exceeds the 1024-token window by 50 tokens after mutation at that default; the explicitly tighter 64-token supersede reservation admits all three displayed requests and all three planned actions. This establishes a bounded possible request path, not universal framing incompatibility or model competence.
assessment.limits: No trained generation, semantic quality, live-agent success, model normalization, model-startup cost or model latency is established by tokenizer-only preflight. Exact retained requests are replayable; different model-generated history can change the budget.
assessment.next_gate: Prepare and independently review a revision-pinned provenance-bound pretrained safetensors normalization, prove unchanged strict snapshot admission, then predeclare campaign bounds and acceptance criteria before actual model-generated tool episodes. No weights or normalizer implementation is part of this source tranche.
remaining_dependencies: Source-reviewed offline safetensors normalization with immutable upstream provenance and learned-tensor preservation.
Unchanged strict consumer snapshot admission using actual pretrained weights.
A predeclared qualification manifest with model, task, runtime, bounds and acceptance thresholds.
Actual model-generated tool episodes and independently verified failure-inclusive results across all eight intents.
